questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A roundabout is coming. Slow down and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming where you may need to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you to be careful. This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive slowly and carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that railroad tracks are ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign is posted at traffic lights. It means you cannot turn right when the light is red at that location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it to pass other cars or drive straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road may be slippery when wet. Be careful in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you to be careful. This sign tells you that construction ahead will change your normal route. Be ready to follow a different path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the shoulder is lower than the paved road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm is extended upward, they are signaling a right turn. If you are following this driver, adjust your driving accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people crossing the street. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are about to combine into one lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction zone. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that wet pavement can be slippery and make it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves in the direction the arrow points. In this case, the road curves sharply left. Multiple chevron signs may mark the entire curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. Slow down to the safe speed shown (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming conditions and hazards. This sign warns that farm machinery may be on the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. HOV lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver plus one or more passengers. Only these vehicles can use the lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign showing the maximum legal speed for the road. Do not drive faster than this speed. In bad weather or poor conditions like rain, snow, or ice, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in the direction you are heading. Turn around and go the other way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. Regulatory signs display rules that drivers must follow. This sign means large trucks are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will leave the freeway. You have two choices: change lanes to continue on the freeway, or stay in your lane and exit. You cannot continue straight through the interchange in an exit-only lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It is white and rectangular with black markings. Drivers must obey all regulatory signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming conditions and hazards. This sign warns that traffic is coming from both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming conditions and hazards. This sign warns that bicycles may cross the road in this area.
